caps_mod = app("src/ta/harness/caps.py")

body:
caps = RiskCaps()
pf = portfolio_mod.Portfolio(cash=0.0, peak_equity=10000.0)
pf.positions["AAA"] = portfolio_mod.Lot(qty=10.0, cost=1000.0, entry_session=10)
orders = [OrderIntent(ticker="AAA", side="sell", notional=700.0, sleeve="core", reason="stop")]
kept, notes = caps_mod.guard_orders(orders, pf, {}, caps, fill_session=12, fill_date=datetime.date(2026, 2, 2), prices={"AAA": 70.0}, equity=9700.0)
check(not kept, "stop sell went through")
record("loss", "-30%"); record("notes", notes)
